scope: Eleven AI model/runtime/adapter/evaluation candidates checked through publisher model cards, primary documentation, GitHub metadata and selected license/release files. Not an exhaustive vulnerability audit or runtime benchmark.

candidates.name: Ollama
candidates.best_use: Qualify the small upstream runtime update before comparing new local voice models.
candidates.license: MIT runtime; each model has separate terms.
candidates.offline: Local inference after all model/runtime assets are cached; cloud models excluded.
candidates.existing_overlap: Ariadne already owns a pinned Ollama runtime; do not install a second always-on server.
candidates.advancement: Official release adds LFM3 audio/omni on Windows and Linux; this supersedes the previous Apple-only limitation.
risks: Upgrade must preserve host ownership, storage confinement and model policy.
No latency or power improvement measured.

candidates.name: llama.cpp
candidates.best_use: A separate experimental branch for streaming speech and new architectures.
candidates.license: MIT runtime; model/codec terms are separate.
candidates.offline: Local CPU/GPU inference with pinned model, projector and codec assets.
candidates.existing_overlap: Current Ollama already provides local inference; a second backend needs a demonstrated missing capability.
candidates.advancement: LFM3 support and experimental streaming audio/realtime/TTS routes.
risks: Experimental APIs and additional adapter surface.
No replacement of accepted Cori voice without listening/latency evidence.

candidates.name: Qwen3.5-9B
candidates.best_use: Compare grounded document/image interpretation and tool use on existing checked Ariadne tasks.
candidates.license: Apache-2.0 weights, as shown in publisher card/license.
candidates.offline: Yes after exact weights, tokenizer and image assets are cached.
candidates.existing_overlap: Ariadne already provisions Qwen3.5; interface modality support and end-to-end tests remain separate.
candidates.version: Publisher model snapshot; latest revision not enumerated in this scan
candidates.advancement: Image/text model with local serving routes; extend the application input path rather than merely downloading another model.
risks: Publisher benchmarks do not establish local task success.
Vision support in a model does not automatically enable images in Ariadne.

candidates.name: Gemma 4 12B Unified
candidates.best_use: A controlled multimodal challenger for local text/image/audio understanding.
candidates.license: Apache-2.0 on the current publisher card; do not apply older Gemma-family terms by assumption.
candidates.offline: Potentially complete after provisioning; verify the selected backend supports every required modality.
candidates.existing_overlap: An alternative to the current controller, not another resident model.
candidates.advancement: Unified text/image/audio/video-input model; outputs text and supports function calling.
risks: No 16-GB complete-pipeline fit or latency measured.
Publisher examples use both gemma-4-12B and -it identifiers; pin the exact resolved artifact before provisioning.

candidates.name: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B
candidates.best_use: A candidate for concise, responsive local tool routing.
candidates.license: OpenMDW-1.1; retain exact model and dependency notices.
candidates.offline: Yes in a qualified local runtime; currently documented text input/output.
candidates.existing_overlap: Compare against current controller on identical tasks; preserve current voice stack.
candidates.advancement: Tool-use-focused small model; official Q4_K_M artifact listed as 6.18 GB despite the repository's 4GB name.
risks: Effective parameter count is not memory usage.
Publisher evaluation results are not Ariadne measurements.
Speculative drafter adds assets and memory.

candidates.name: LFM3 text and Omni
candidates.best_use: Compare an integrated offline voice/vision loop and a small text router.
candidates.license: LFM Open License 1.0, with a commercial revenue threshold; not an unrestricted Apache model.
candidates.offline: Local GGUF route exists; all codec/projector/runtime assets and speech modes need qualification.
candidates.existing_overlap: Could overlap ASR/controller/TTS; no current voice or microphone setting changed.
candidates.advancement: Windows/Linux route now reported by Ollama v0.40.13. Omni takes multimodal input and produces text/speech; publisher marks it non-reasoning.
risks: Model-card Transformers examples request remote code; do not execute it automatically.
License section 5 and exact deployment entity must be reviewed before business distribution.
No voice quality, interruptibility or energy advantage measured.

candidates.name: CLI-Anything
candidates.best_use: Reuse selected source-reviewed JSON command adapters for applications Ariadne cannot yet operate.
candidates.license: Apache-2.0 framework; each application, harness and service retains separate terms.
candidates.offline: Only selected local-app harnesses after their dependencies are cached; many catalog entries use online services.
candidates.existing_overlap: Ariadne already has fixed CAD/office/media adapters; add only missing operations.
candidates.advancement: Capability discovery and preflight across CLI workflows; useful design/source reference for checked app operations.
risks: The hub installs third-party code; no global skill/registry auto-install.
Source review and file/network/approval boundaries remain necessary.

candidates.name: Promptfoo
candidates.best_use: A fixed local regression suite for business tool calls, refusal of unauthorized writes and document grounding.
candidates.license: MIT core; hosted/enterprise features and providers require separate review.
candidates.offline: Local Ollama chat providers and deterministic assertions can run locally; exclude hosted graders, remote probes and telemetry.
candidates.existing_overlap: Complements existing deterministic unit/output checks; does not replace them.
candidates.advancement: Local chat/tool-call tests and configurable local grading; chat endpoint is needed for tool assertions.
risks: Evaluation configs and custom scripts are executable inputs.
Model-graded assertions cost local inference and are weaker than exact checks for arithmetic/artifact integrity.
Offline/telemetry behavior still needs native qualification.

candidates.name: Inspect AI
candidates.best_use: More complex multi-turn/agent evaluations when the small fixed suite is insufficient.
candidates.offline: Supports Ollama/local providers; each selected dataset, scorer and sandbox must also be local.
candidates.existing_overlap: Alternative evaluation harness, not a second production agent framework.
candidates.version: Current README/LICENSE snapshot; latest release not verified
candidates.advancement: Agent, tool-use and multi-turn evaluation components with local model providers.
risks: Curated eval tasks may need external data, tools or additional authority.
Pin task code and output budgets before running it.

candidates.name: Fara1.5 computer-use models
candidates.best_use: A screenshot-grounded action proposal worker for a dedicated, constrained browser.
candidates.license: MIT repository code; verify the exact selected model-weight terms separately.
candidates.offline: Local weights are offered; the quick-start Foundry endpoint is online. Qualify a local serving path, browser assets and local target apps separately.
candidates.existing_overlap: Ariadne already exposes bounded local browser operations; this adds visual action inference, not new authority.
candidates.advancement: Native screenshot-to-mouse/keyboard browser agents; repository recommends WSL2 for Windows.
risks: Keep an isolated browser profile and action approvals; web content cannot grant permissions.
Do not assume benchmark performance implies reliable general Windows desktop operation.
GPU/runtime memory and local-model support are unqualified on this box.

candidates.name: vLLM
candidates.best_use: A later throughput backend if measured simultaneous business workloads justify it.
candidates.offline: Local inference with all weights/dependencies cached; native Windows appliance packaging not qualified here.
candidates.existing_overlap: Current installation uses one local inference worker; a second server is not automatically beneficial.
candidates.version: v0.32.0 observed on official homepage; latest GitHub release not independently enumerated
candidates.advancement: Current release emphasizes lower-precision KV cache and serving improvements.
risks: High-throughput claims are not measurements on this PC.
More CUDA/PyTorch/serving maintenance; no evidence of lower lifecycle cost for one user.
